newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil average daily exports in Feb at $174.3 mln. [CORRECTED 15:37 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil average daily exports in Feb at $174.3 mln. [CORRECTED 15:37 GMT]

text.p: Brazil has exported $2.266 billion in goods so far in February with daily average exports standing at $174.3 million, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said (Ministry corrects the month-to-date export figure).
The spokeswoman said exports in the third week of the month totalled $936 million or $187.3 million a day.
Exports in February 1996 were $3.405 billion with a daily average of $180.1 million.
Predictions for February point to a $1.5 billion trade gap because of problems the new Siscomex computer system had in registering fuel imports in January by state oil firm Petrobras.
